silver.name: ice-blast
silver.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Single ice explosion pickup medallion for a retro top-down shooter, same family as polished circular game bonuses. Silver beveled metal outer rim with dark recesses and bright upper-left highlights, thin lime green inset ring, glossy saturated cyan-blue glass interior. Center symbol is a bold luminous lemon yellow FOUR POINT STARBURST: narrow long vertical lower spike, two shorter diagonal/side spikes, small upward point. Reference motif is a yellow ice blast star on blue circle. Perfectly round, front facing, centered, diameter90% of square. Clean bold readable at32px. Painted3D game icon finish, not flat vector. Exactly one isolated icon, transparent alpha corners, no exterior glow/shadow, no snowflake, no text, no numbers, no extra objects.
